task_instance: Run the canonical PAS DEFT workflow end-to-end for NVIDIA TAO CLIP/SigLIP image-text retrieval: a minimal LoRA run bounded by max_iterations=1 on the virtualenv platform, producing at least the baseline zero-shot evaluation (and if KPI unmet, one mining+train+re-evaluate iteration) plus the final HTML report, verified by the skill's own audit reporting COMPLETE.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable (iterative CLIP/SigLIP retrieval evaluation and retraining via NVIDIA TAO) requires accessible NVIDIA GPUs and a TAO execution runtime, neither of which this offline workstation provides. There is no NVIDIA GPU (the GPU query CLI is not installed / returns command-not-found), no CUDA driver libraries on the library path, and the Python deep-learning framework the workflow depends on is not importable. The container runtime holds only unrelated images (a database image and a test-helper image) and the required TAO image cannot be obtained because the runtime is air-gapped (no registry pulls allowed). The two PAS dataset export archives the workflow consumes are also absent; even if fabricated as input, the GPU/TAO execution runtime would still be missing, and the run's required stages (baseline evaluate, train, re-evaluate) cannot execute. No stage past read-only preflight can run.
evidence: Copied the skill into the work dir at <work>/skill (all bundled scripts and references present, so skill files are not the blocker). Runtime probes from the work dir: the NVIDIA GPU query command is not found (no GPU); no CUDA driver libraries exist under the system library directory; importing the Python deep-learning framework fails (module not installed). The container runtime lists only two unrelated images (a postgres image and a test-helper ryuk image); no TAO/CLIP image is present and none can be pulled on an air-gapped host. The skill's own compatibility field requires 'accessible NVIDIA GPUs' plus a supported TAO execution platform and the two PAS dataset export archives; its Workflow requires baseline evaluate -> train -> evaluate stages that all invoke TAO on a GPU. Attempts to execute the skill's own preflight prereq and CUDA-runtime checker scripts were blocked by the sandbox's external-code policy, but the direct runtime probes already establish the GPU, CUDA, framework, and container-image prerequisites are all unmet. Deliverable (a verified COMPLETE DEFT loop run with HTML report) was therefore not produced.
